name: @tediware/tedi
description: Official command-line client for the Tediware platform. Thin client over the Tediware API: X12 reference lookup, scrubbing and inspecting your own EDI files, your organization's EDI traffic, and an MCP bridge.
author: Tediware

oclif.description:
ʕ·ᴥ·ʔ  Official command-line client for the Tediware platform https://tediware.com.

Look up the X12 reference (x12). Work with your own EDI files (edi). Read and drive your organization's EDI traffic (transaction, result, feed, artifact, partner, trace). Bridge the platform's MCP server to a stdio client (mcp).

Built for interactive and scripted use alike:

- Auth: `tedi auth login`, or set TEDI_API_KEY in the environment. The key is never a flag.
- Exit codes: 0 ran clean, 1 a finding about your input, 2 did not run or cannot be trusted. Never treat 2 as a pass.
- Locality: `edi obfuscate` never leaves the machine; every command that talks to the server says so in the first line of its help, and local ones say "Local. Nothing is sent.".
- Output: --json on your own data, `--format markdown` for reports and reference pages, no color when piped.

warn-if-update-available.message: tedi <%= config.version %> is installed and <%= latest %> is available. Run `tedi update`.

artifact.description: Download the documents a flow stored: the EDI, translations and outputs on a trace.

auth.description: Authenticate with the Tediware platform and inspect the credential in use.

config.description: Read and write local tedi configuration.

connection.description: Your SFTP, AS2 and sandbox connections, and the partners on each. Read-only.

edi.description: Work with your own EDI files: obfuscate personal data locally, or inspect an interchange.

envelope.description: Your envelopes: the ISA and GS identifiers on each side of a partnership. Read-only.

feed.description: The feed of delivered documents and errors across your organization, oldest first.

flow.description: Your flows: status, schedule, and the graph of nodes each runs. Read-only.

implementation.description: Your own implementations: the schema a mapping targets, the guide, the portable export. Read-only.

mapping.description: Your mappings: what each targets and reads from, its versions, and the transformation. Read-only.

mcp.description: Connect an AI agent to Tediware over the Model Context Protocol.

partner.description: Your trading partners: list them, inspect one, submit documents to or from one.

result.description: Processing results: one node's work on one document, with its error and artifacts.

source.description: Your sources: sample JSON of what you send, and the mappings reading each. Read-only.

transaction.description: EDI transactions: the documents sent to and received from partners, with their envelopes and outcomes.

x12.description: Look up the X12 reference standard (segments, elements, transaction sets).
